scope: Read-only selection of terminal MX phase data; no active routing state/logs or cluster mutation
selection_rules: Recursive regular files only inside the exact selected paths; no symlinks or parent escapes
Include command-*.json created by the MX batch/cleanup; no preparation or unrelated credential receipts
Exclude active RR state.json, continuation STATUS/exit and ongoing routing/controller logs until whole-campaign termination
Create a NEW read-only completed-file inventory of SHA256 and byte length on the stable host; capture it locally before transfer; do not alter frozen inputs
Existing batch evidence-sha256.json is historical and predates later state/analysis/CPU cleanup; preserve it but do not treat it as the final copy manifest
Verify received file bytes against the NEW inventory, then merge with unchanged original local preflight files and seal complete local archive
